rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; ABIDE I from 17 different sites, ABIDE II from 19 different sites
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "ABIDE I includes a total of 1,112 participants (539 autism, 573 NAI) from 17 different sites, and ABIDE II includes 1,114 participants (521 autism, 593 NAI) from 19 different sites."

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) used as reference cohort for normative model training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "we leveraged the large-scale, publicly available Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) data sets (Di Martino et al., 2014, 2017)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE I (Di Martino et al., 2014) and ABIDE II (Di Martino et al., 2017) combined; nonautistic individuals (NAI) served as reference cohort
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We combined the ABIDE repositories I (Di Martino et al., 2014) and II (Di Martino et al., 2017)."

rci5_n.detail: Training set = 90% of NAI; NAI for normative modeling (male-only primary analysis) = 744; training N derived as 90% × 744 = ~670. Exact training N not explicitly stated.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The data set was split into a training set consisting of 90% of NAI and a test set consisting of all autistic individuals and the remaining 10% of NAI." / "This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 NAI between 5 and 64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis."
rci5_n.location: Meijer2024.pdf.md: Method / Normative Modeling, L89; Method / Participants, L59

rci6_sex.detail: Primary analyses were conducted in males only due to limited female sample size. Training set is therefore entirely male. Training male N derived as 90% × 744 = ~670.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "primary analyses were conducted in males only due to limited sample size of females (N autism = 130, N NAI = 280)."
